messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide you can follow to get your acoustic guitar sold quickly—and hopefully at a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1️⃣ Clean & Tune** | Give it a quick wash/clean, remove dust from fretboard, and make sure it plays straight. If you’re not comfortable doing this yourself, bring it to a shop for a free checkup. | A well‑presented instrument looks more appealing and shows buyers you’ve cared for it. | | **2️⃣ Take High‑Quality Photos** | • Use natural light.
• Capture front, back, side, headstock, strings, bridge, sound hole, and any wear marks.
• Include a reference object (like a coin) so size is clear.| Great pictures reduce buyer hesitation and help set realistic expectations. | | **3️⃣ Write a Clear Listing Description** | • Brand + Model
• Year / age estimate
• Condition notes (“minor scratches”, “no cracks”)
• Any extras (case, strap, tuner)
• Reason for selling (upgrade, moving, etc.)
• Price justification (market comps). | Transparency builds trust and speeds up negotiations. | | **4️⃣ Research Market Value** | Check recent sales on eBay, Reverb, Gearslutz, Facebook Groups, and local listings. Aim for a competitive but realistic asking price—usually 10–20 % below what similar models fetch if you want speed. | Overpricing stalls sales; underpricing leaves money on the table. | | **5️⃣ Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | *Online marketplaces* – eBay, Reverb, Etsy (for vintage gear), Amazon Handmade.
*Local classifieds* – Craigslist, Gumtree, Nextdoor.
*Social media* – Facebook Marketplace, Instagram Stories/Reels, dedicated groups like “UK Acoustic Guitars” or “NYC Guitar Sellers.”
*Physical venues* – Local record stores, music schools, pawnshops, consignment shops. | Multiple outlets increase visibility. Online gives reach; local reduces shipping hassles. | | **6️⃣ Set Up Shipping (if applicable)** | • Get sturdy packaging: padded envelope or custom crate.
• Insure against loss/damage (often $25-$50 per shipment).
• Offer multiple options: standard vs expedited. | Buyers appreciate clarity on cost/time; insurance protects both parties. | | **7️⃣ Safety First** | • Meet in public places (coffee shop, police station lobby).
• Bring a friend if possible.
• Verify payment before handing over the guitar (cash, Venmo, PayPal Goods & Services). | Reduces risk of fraud or theft. | | **8️⃣ Negotiate Smartly** | • Stick close to your minimum acceptable price.
• Be prepared to explain why you value it as such.
• Keep communication polite and professional. | Good negotiation skills often seal the deal faster. | | **9️⃣ Close the Sale** | • Sign a simple receipt noting serial number, sale price, and date.
• Transfer ownership paperwork if required (some states require a bill of sale). | Provides legal protection for both sides. | ### Quick Tips & Common Pitfalls | Tip | Explanation | |-----|-------------| | **Use a Serial Number** | Helps verify authenticity and prevents disputes later. | | **Avoid “Too Good To Be True” Offers** | Scammers may offer high cash upfront then ask for additional fees. | | **Don’t Rush** | Patience pays off—you’ll likely get better offers than hasty decisions. | | **Keep Records** | Save screenshots of ads, emails, receipts—useful if there’s ever confusion. | --- #### Sample Ad Template ``` 🎸 For Sale: Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar 🎶 Year: 2010 | New Strings (D’Addario EJ16) Condition: - Minor scuffs near nut area, otherwise pristine. - No cracks or warps. - Comes with original case, strap, and cleaning kit. Price: £250 (negotiable within reason) Why I'm selling: Moving abroad next month. 📦 Will ship via insured courier (£15 extra) OR meet locally in London (Central Station). Contact me via DM or email: example@email.com. Thank you! 🙏 ``` Feel free to tweak wording to match your style. Once posted, monitor responses promptly—buyers love fast replies! Good luck with your sale! Let me know if you'd like help drafting specific posts or choosing between platforms.
message.reasoning:
The user asks "How can I sell my acoustic guitar?" They want advice. We need to provide guidance: listing platforms (eBay, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace), local classifieds, pawn shops, music stores, online forums; prepare photos, description, condition, price research; shipping considerations; safety tips.

We don't have to call the tool because it's about tuning an instrument. So no function calls needed. Just answer with helpful steps.
